description: Department of Archaeology - The Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188) Notification Under Section 33, Area reserved for Archaeological Purposes of Beligala Rock
reasoning: This gazette notification declares a specific area of state land as an "archaeological reserve" under the Antiquities Ordinance. The content primarily deals with land matters, including detailed boundary descriptions, land surveys, and specific plot identification (Lot 1 in Preliminary Plan No. Ke. 2785). It involves the reservation of land for archaeological purposes, which falls under land and property-related matters classification.
